# Lanesra OS — Detailed Product Context

Lanesra OS is an independent, open-source business application designed for small businesses that need more structure than spreadsheets but less complexity than enterprise CRM and ERP platforms.

## Product status

The product is currently in Early Access v0.13.0. The public browser demo is usable and includes realistic sample data, including a fully working Admin panel. The Windows desktop application is in early development: the source is public today (Tauri v2 + Rust + SQLite), with the full sales lifecycle already working end to end - Companies, Contacts, Products, Opportunities, Quotes, Orders and Invoices, including quote-to-order and order-to-invoice conversion, atomic document numbering and local user authentication. Also working: Contracts, Tasks, user management, Team Workspace mode for small teams (Docker), whole-workspace backup and restore, self-service password change, PDF generation and printing, and CSV import/export. On top of that fixed schema, an Admin panel now ships: user & role management (moved out of the main navigation into its own section), an editable business profile (name, phone, address, city, logo) used across the workspace and on print letterheads, reports beyond the dashboard plus a simple custom report builder (pick an object, group by any field including custom fields, count or sum), custom fields on every major object - Companies, Contacts, Opportunities, Quotes, Orders, Invoices, Contracts, Products and Tasks - not just Companies and Contacts, conditional business rules and workflow automation generalized across those same objects (auto-creating follow-up tasks when a record's status or stage changes to a chosen value), admin-configurable ID/numbering formats per object (choose the prefix and digit width, e.g. "ACC-000001" or "ACC-ab0001", without resetting the underlying sequence), and a dashboard KPI picker so admins choose which tiles show. There is no signed installer yet; it is built and run from source, or from an unsigned Early Access Windows installer on GitHub Releases.

## Product history

- May 2026: Product idea and vision defined.
- June 2026: Architecture, scope and offline strategy established.
- July 2026: Design system and web MVP built.
- August 2026: Public Early Access launched.
- August 2026: Windows desktop edition foundation published (Tauri + SQLite, full sales lifecycle).
- August 2026: Contracts, Tasks and user management added on desktop.
- August 2026: Team Workspace mode, backup/restore, and self-service password change shipped.
- August 2026: PDF generation/printing and CSV import/export shipped.
- August 2026: An admin-configurable layer shipped on top of the fixed schema - branding and print customization, reports beyond the dashboard, custom fields on Companies and Contacts, conditional business rules over those fields, and Phase 1 workflow automation (auto-created follow-up tasks on Opportunity/Invoice status changes).
- August 2026: An Admin panel shipped generalizing that layer across nearly every object - user & role management, editable business profile with phone, custom fields/business rules/workflow automation on Companies, Contacts, Opportunities, Quotes, Orders, Invoices, Contracts, Products and Tasks, admin-configurable numbering formats, a simple custom report builder and a dashboard KPI picker. The online demo was updated to mirror the same Admin panel in the browser.
- Next milestone: a code-signed installer and task reminder notifications.

## Core workflows

Customer records connect to contacts, opportunities, quotes, orders, invoices, contracts and tasks. Opportunities are optional for quotes. Quotes are optional for orders. Orders are optional for invoices. Relationship dropdowns are filtered by customer to preserve data integrity. Quotes, orders and invoices include product or service line items with quantities and pricing.

## Product principles

- Open source and transparent
- No licence activation
- Simple by default
- Modern user experience
- Local data ownership, now working in the early-access desktop edition
- Public roadmap and changelog
